ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in Figure 1, the Sun is located near the center of the figure, and Earth is marked on the relatively outer orbit; celestial body M is located inside Earth's orbit, in the inner region close to the Sun. Then reason: M is located inside Earth's orbit, indicating that it may be an inferior planet. Inferior planets include Mercury and Venus; the question only requires giving one possibility, so Mercury can be answered.

raw_record.question_text:
Read Figure 1 and answer the following questions.

<image1>

What planet is one possibility for celestial body M in Figure 1?

method.method_draft: 先观察图像：太阳位于中心附近，地球在较外侧轨道上，M位于地球轨道以内、靠近太阳的内侧轨道上。由此判断M是地内行星。地内行星包括水星和金星；题目只要求说出一种可能，所以可答：水星。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图1中太阳位于图的中心附近，地球标在较外侧的轨道上；M天体位于地球轨道以内，处在靠近太阳的内侧区域。再推理：M位于地球轨道以内，说明它可能是地内行星。地内行星包括水星和金星；题目只要求说出一种可能，因此可答水星。
method.CoT_answer_check_final: 先描述图像：图1中太阳位于图的中心附近，地球标在较外侧的轨道上；M天体位于地球轨道以内，处在靠近太阳的内侧区域。再推理：M位于地球轨道以内，说明它可能是地内行星。地内行星包括水星和金星；题目只要求说出一种可能，因此可答水星。
method.CoT_qualify_0: 候选推理先描述图像再推理，视觉描述与图中太阳、地球轨道和M的位置关系一致；推理符合方法草稿，最终答案“水星”与标准答案一致。
method.CoT_final: 先描述图像：图1中太阳位于图的中心附近，地球标在较外侧的轨道上；M天体位于地球轨道以内，处在靠近太阳的内侧区域。再推理：M位于地球轨道以内，说明它可能是地内行星。地内行星包括水星和金星；题目只要求说出一种可能，因此可答水星。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Uses direct comparison of the drawn orbital paths: M is on an orbit enclosed by Earth's orbit, so it must be an inner planet; Mercury is one valid inner-planet possibility. This is the most straightforward visual-orbit route.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the diagram as a heliocentric sketch: the Sun is labeled near the center, Earth is labeled on a larger outer orbit, and M is a small body on an inner orbit closer to the Sun than Earth's orbit.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the wording “M天体的一种可能是哪个行星” to know only one valid candidate is needed, not all possible candidates.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: In the solar system, the planets whose orbits lie inside Earth's orbit are Mercury and Venus. If asked for one possible planet, Mercury is acceptable.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中标出太阳、地球和M，M位于太阳附近且比地球更靠内侧。再用太阳系行星由内向外的顺序判断：水星、金星、地球依次排列。因此在地球以内的M可能是水星或金星。题目问一种可能，填水星即可。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图1中标出了“太阳”“地球”和“M”。图中M是一个小天体，位于太阳附近的内侧轨道上，并且比地球所在轨道更靠近太阳。再推理：太阳系行星由内向外的顺序是水星、金星、地球等，所以在地球轨道以内的行星可能是水星或金星。题目问M天体的一种可能，填水星即可。

method.CoT_qualify_0: 推理过程符合要求：先描述图像，再依据太阳系行星顺序推理；结论“水星”与标准答案一致。图像中确实可见太阳、地球和M，且M位于比地球更靠近太阳的位置。无需实质修改。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Weakly distinct: instead of starting from orbit enclosure alone, it uses the Sun-to-planet order rule after locating M as closer to the Sun than Earth. It reaches the same candidate set through planetary sequence knowledge.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the relative positions in the diagram: M is drawn nearer to the Sun than Earth and is not labeled as Earth or the Sun; Earth is farther out on the outer revolution path.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question’s singular/open phrasing “一种可能” to select one member of the possible set rather than requiring a unique identification.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Recall the order of planets outward from the Sun: Mercury, Venus, Earth. Therefore any planet shown inside Earth's position/orbit could be Mercury or Venus; Mercury is the first such planet.
